newsitem.title: USA: Second 650 MW Homer City, Pa., coal unit restarts.
newsitem.headline: Second 650 MW Homer City, Pa., coal unit restarts.

text.p: The second 650 megawatt (MW) unit at the coal-fired generating station in Homer City, Pa., resumed operation after being shut last week for boiler tube repair, the operator said Wednesday.
"It's back. It's at 350 MW," said a spokeswoman for GPU Generation Inc when asked about the operating status of Homer City's unit 2.
The return of Homer City 2 followed Tuesday's startup of the facility's unit 3, which is also rated at 650 MW.
Homer City's unit 1, with similar generating capacity, was running at full output, the spokeswoman added.
Pennsylvania Electric Co (Penelec) and New York Electric & Gas Corp each have a 50 percent stake in the Homer City units.
Both Penelec and GPU Generation are subsidiaries of GPU Inc of Parsippany, N.J.
The three Homer City units represent 11 percent of GPU Inc's total generating capacity.
